decisions.reason: The existing Event captures Danish coverage for all interactive-field labels but leaves the Requirement scope restricted to style names; the source necessarily adds all interactive fields while preserving the existing style-name context.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Here is the translated version.

Two things.

Check all interactive fields.
Make sure all interactive fields have a label saying the same as the first step (see image.png).

decisions.reason: Requiring labels on all interactive fields does not change whether field contents are independent or duplicated.
The label rule does not replace, resolve, or modify the separately specified grey visual cue for editable-field discoverability.
Label text and coverage do not affect retention of formatting in the Title field.
A persistent label matching initial placeholder text does not change the requirement that the field placeholder clear when clicked.
The source specifies label coverage and text, not the underlying text-entry representation or architecture.
Although date fields may receive labels under the source Requirement, their calendar-dropdown selection behavior remains unchanged.
The all-fields label rule does not alter whether the Board Meeting dropdown control is enabled or how it operates.
The source does not change the checklist control type or its enabled state.
Interactive-field label text and coverage are unrelated to inclusion of customer theme colors.
The source adds a field-label rule but does not modify the prescribed style catalog or its deployment across templates.
The interactive-field label decision does not affect bullet sizing, balance, alignment, reference design, or color.
